Aave V4 was built under a security-first framework. Security was never treated as a final gate before deployment. Instead, security controls were layered across the entire development lifecycle, starting from early architectural decisions and continuing through to post-audit fix validation. The result: approximately 345 days of cumulative security review across manual audits, formal verification, invariant testing, fuzzing, and a public security contest. As part of its strategy to make DeFi more accessible to everyday users, MetaMask selected Aave as its DeFi lending partner to power Stablecoin Earn, a feature that lets users earn yield directly inside their wallet. EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 (both scheduled for inclusion) adjust the cost of creating and accessing state so that gas prices more accurately track the real work each operation takes. Replaying historical mainnet transactions under the new schedule shows that a small set of smart contracts rely on assumptions the new schedule shifts, which may lead to these contracts breaking or degrading without preventative updates. PRESS RELEASE ECB President Lagarde to step down on 7 February 2027 29 October 2026 European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde today informed the Governing Council and the President of the European Council António Costa that she will step down from her position on 7 February 2027. President Lagarde’s successor will be appointed by the European Council following the nomination process outlined in Article 283 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. The Governing Council thanked President Lagarde warmly and gave her a long standing ovation. For media queries, please contact Eszter Miltényi-Torstensson , mobile: +4917176953

The company said in its latest security advisory that the cybercriminals took Fireworks’ customers’ billing information and some datasets. Norwest , a firm backed solely by Wells Fargo, has raised a $4 billion fund as it sets out to invest more in AI. This is the eighteenth fund for the 65-year-old multi-stage investment firm, and its largest to date. The fund will be invested across various sectors and multiple countries, notably the United States, India, and Israel. But the big story here is AI, and Norwest’s plans to expand its investment in this area.
